mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact matrix orthogonality, order-2p recurrence, unipotent powers, odd-trace quadratic histograms, all cyclic carry Gram factorization and algebraic exceptional row counts.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: F_p exact signed integer residues; integer exponent histograms in Q(zeta_p); no floating-point mathematics.
mathematics.conventions: j=x+p*y, f(j)=(x^3,y^3), exponent xj*xk+2*xj*yk+yj*yk, all shifts modulo p^2. Formal constant means constant on all of F_p.

bounds.powers: C^k for 0<=k<2p; even traces m=2k and odd traces m=2k+1
bounds.omitted_at_17: Full Gram phase histogram comparison only; carry and exceptional classification remain exhaustive.

non_claims: No asymptotic theorem from finite success.
No actual BGS map is tested.
No full Gram histogram factorization at p=17.
The imported Abel theorem is not numerically tested or re-proved.
